column1: # Route coverage inventory (issue #169). Every key in src/routes/route-paths.ts must appear
# here at least once, naming the spec that actually exercises it in a browser. Rows are
# validated in both directions by scripts/ci/check-e2e-route-coverage.ts (make check-e2e-route-coverage):
# an undeclared route, a stale row, a missing spec file, or a spec outside its suite root fails.
# suite is one of: e2e, visual, allowlisted. An allowlisted route is intentionally out of
# browser scope, must state the reason in details, and must not also carry a suite row.
